lines.zh: 我离地半寸，气托着脚底。
lines.en: I float half an inch up on a cushion of ki.
My golden hair streams back.

lines.zh: 步子很轻，落地却不留声。
lines.en: My steps are light and leave no sound.

lines.zh: 我边走边收着气，怕惊动四周。
lines.en: I walk while holding my ki in, wary of stirring the area.

lines.zh: 剑鞘贴在背上，随步子敲。
lines.en: My scabbard taps my back with each step.

lines.zh: 我从树顶掠过，叶子才后知后觉地动。
lines.en: I skim the treetops; the leaves react a beat late.

lines.zh: 气在身周拉出一圈淡淡的光。
lines.en: A faint ring of light trails me.

lines.zh: 我落回地面，草被压弯又弹起。
lines.en: I drop back down; the grass bends and springs up.

lines.zh: 我绕过村子，不想让他们看见。
lines.en: I skirt the village so they will not see me.

lines.zh: 脚步一紧，我加快了一截。
lines.en: My stride tightens and I gain speed.

lines.zh: 我踩着气走，像踩在看不见的台阶上。
lines.en: I walk on ki as if on unseen steps.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的气往上升
lines.en: I step up on my own ki and rise.

lines.zh: 我站着，金色气焰慢慢收拢。
lines.en: I stand while the gold aura settles.

lines.zh: 头发垂到肩上，还在轻轻动。
lines.en: My hair rests on my shoulders, still stirring.
I stare into my own palm.
This timeline can still be saved.
Ki moves in me like a river.

lines.zh: 我把手按在剑柄上，又松开。
lines.en: I rest my hand on the hilt, then let go.

lines.zh: 风吹过，我的衣角一直没落下。
lines.en: The wind passes; my coat hem never falls.
I hear crying far away.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，把它记下来。
lines.en: I close my eyes and remember it.
Stones beneath me lift slightly.
I set them back down.

lines.zh: 气焰短了一截，我又补上。
lines.en: My aura shortens; I feed it again.
I look at the sky for a long time.

lines.zh: 我转过头，眼睛是青色的。
lines.en: I turn; my eyes are teal.
Your ki is clean.

lines.zh: 我打量你，判断你是不是敌人。
lines.en: I size you up, deciding if you are a foe.
You are hurt; your stance leans.

lines.zh: 我伸手，把一颗豆子递给你。
lines.en: I hold out a bean to you.
Eat it and you will heal faster.

lines.zh: 你别靠太近，我的气会烫。
lines.en: Do not come too close; my ki burns.

lines.zh: 我压低声音，跟你说清楚。
lines.en: I lower my voice and explain.
Can you show me the way?
One look at you and I understand.
I push my sword further behind me.
You need not fear me.
I nod, then look to the distance.
Stay here; I will go.
My shadow splits in two.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹乱，我没管。
lines.en: Wind tangles my hair; I let it.
I inhale; the pain is dull and deep.

lines.zh: 这一下让我气乱了一拍。
lines.en: The blow scatters my ki for a beat.
Blood shows at my mouth.
Blood drips from my chin onto the ground.
My aura shortens.
I grit my teeth and raise it again.
The wound burns.
I wipe it with the back of my hand.
It is not over yet.
I look up; my eyes are brighter.
I push the food back.

lines.zh: 赛亚人吃得很多，但现在不是时候。
lines.en: Saiyans eat a lot, but not now.
I take the water and drink it down.
I take a bite and chew slowly.
Before a fight I eat only a little.
Thank you; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我的手停在半空，又收回来。
lines.en: My hand stops in the air, then withdraws.
I still need my strength.

lines.zh: 等结束了，我再好好吃一顿。
lines.en: When it is over, I will eat properly.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的气把你托住。
lines.en: You collide with me; my ki catches you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，怕把你撞飞。
lines.en: I step back so I do not send you flying.

lines.zh: 我们的肩撞在一起，你退了。
lines.en: Our shoulders meet, and you give way.
I reach out and steady you.

lines.zh: 剑鞘撞到你，我立刻侧身。
lines.en: My scabbard hits you; I turn aside at once.
I land too heavily and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 你被气浪推得睁不开眼。
lines.en: The aura's gust makes you shut your eyes.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，有点过意不去。
lines.en: I look down at you, a little sorry.
We pass and each finds footing.
You are not hurt; good.
I push these thoughts back down.
My time is short.

lines.zh: 我望着远方，想起一个人。
lines.en: I look off and think of someone.
Then I put it away.
Ki circles once in my chest.
I cannot think of this now.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放到呼吸上。
lines.en: I put my attention on breathing.
In. Out.
There is still work undone.
I open my eyes; they are clear.
I bend and pick it up.

lines.zh: 它的重量跟看上去不一样。
lines.en: It weighs other than it looks.
I hand it to someone who needs it.
I weigh it, then put it back.
I will keep this.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一握，它没有变形。
lines.en: I grip it gently; it does not deform.
I stuff it into my pack.
This one is very worn.
I wipe it clean.
I glance back once, then go.
The ki thickens; I raise my head.
I have locked onto it.
Stronger than I expected.
My hair brightens a shade.

lines.zh: 我保持距离，先看它的动作。
lines.en: I keep my distance and watch it move first.
It moves; I follow.
I cannot let this drag.
Ki gathers in a light in my palm.
I set my stance.
My mind is very quiet.
The ground quivers under us.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在看哪里，我记住了。
lines.en: I note where its eyes go.
My sword came from the future.
I move first.

lines.zh: 我跟着它的节奏，一点点提速。
lines.en: I match its rhythm and slowly raise the tempo.
It punches; I turn aside.
A ki blast grazes its shoulder.
I follow with another.
It tries to flee; I am already in the way.
I press it toward open ground.
Its ki starts to fray.
I raise my hand and charge.
The soil peels back in rings.
I will not let it breathe.
I come down from above.
Its guard grows desperate.
I hear its heartbeat quicken.

lines.zh: 最后一击前，我停了半秒。
lines.en: Before the last blow, I pause half a second.
Half a second is enough.
I strike.
I cut the wind in two.
I draw my sword only an inch.

lines.zh: 手刀劈下，空气发出裂响。
lines.en: My knife-hand falls; the air cracks.
My elbow slams its chest.
A roundhouse kicks it away.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的手臂，往外一扯。
lines.en: I seize its arm and wrench it wide.
Ki detonates ahead of my fist.
Three strikes; the last one lands honest.
It blocks, so I hit the same spot again.

lines.zh: 我的拳停在它脸前一寸，然后打了。
lines.en: My fist stops an inch from its face, then hits.
A knee takes it off the ground.

lines.zh: 它退到石头边，我一脚踩碎石头。
lines.en: It backs to a rock; I crush the rock.
I strike and shove, driving it back.
My aura heats its armor red.
Its counter grazes my cheek.
I kick it into a tree.
It drops into the dirt; I do not follow.
I shake out my hand.
The light arrives first, then me.

lines.zh: 我从时间线的那头走过来。
lines.en: I walk in from the far end of the timeline.

lines.zh: 空气被我的气撕开一道口。
lines.en: My ki tears an opening in the air.

lines.zh: 落地时，我听到了自己的脚步。
lines.en: On landing, I hear my own footsteps.
This sky is not yet ruined.
There is still time.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，金发在光里发亮。
lines.en: I lift my head; my golden hair glows.
I scan my surroundings.
No one is waiting for me.
Then I will go find them myself.
I take a breath.

lines.zh: 这空气比我的世界干净。
lines.en: This air is cleaner than my world's.
I stand on grass; it bows.
My sword is steady on my back.
I choose a direction.
Wind pushes at my back.
I walk.
The light behind me slowly withdraws.

lines.zh: 火扑到身上，气把它挡在外层。
lines.en: Fire hits me; my ki holds it at the outer edge.
I hit the ground and the dirt erupts.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我把气撑开。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I push my ki outward.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀起来，我在半空稳住。
lines.en: The blast throws me up; I steady in midair.

lines.zh: 那一下打在肩上，我侧了侧身。
lines.en: It hits my shoulder and I angle away.

lines.zh: 咒力勒住我，我把气涨开。
lines.en: Magic constricts me; I swell my ki.

lines.zh: 肚子在叫，我只能压下去。
lines.en: My stomach complains; I press it down.

lines.zh: 雷电落下，我把它引进地里。
lines.en: Lightning falls; I route it into the ground.

lines.zh: 脚下空无一物，我朝上有光的地方冲。
lines.en: Nothing below; I charge toward the light above.
